title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
subtitle: Find clear and quick answers to your questions about bookings and travels in Morocco.
searchPlaceholder: Search a question (e.g. currency, cancellation, riad)...

q1.question: In which currency are bookings charged?
q1.answer: All reservations and transactions at Atlas Voyage are strictly processed in Moroccan Dirhams (MAD). Any displayed prices in Euros (€), US Dollars ($) or British Pounds (£) are purely indicative, based on periodically updated exchange rates.

q2.question: How does cash payment on arrival work?
q2.answer: For eligible stays, you pay zero online. You settle the full amount directly with the local provider upon check-in, in Moroccan Dirhams or by acceptable card.

q3.question: Can I cancel or modify my booking?
q3.answer: Yes. You can cancel your reservation directly from your client space up to 48 hours prior to check-in, subject to the specific policy of the selected offer.

q4.question: Do displayed prices include Moroccan local taxes?
q4.answer: Yes, our prices are all-inclusive (TTC), encompassing the communal city tax and national tourism promotion tax (TPT).
